# Linker

## Links

A dead link: [[Missing Page]].
An ambiguous link: [[Twin]].
An alias link: [[Clean A|the A page]] and a heading link: [[Clean B#Section]].
Also [[Cycle A]], [[Broken Chain]], [[Stale]] and [[Empty Sections]].

## Code

Inline code `[[Inline Ghost]]` is ignored.

```md
[[Fenced Ghost]]
```

~~~
[[Tilde Ghost]]
~~~
